seoTitle: Naya Aasha | New Hope for Every Life
seoDescription: Naya Aasha supports children's education, people living with HIV, and underserved communities in Nepal.
heroTitle: New hope begins when we stand together.
heroText: We work alongside children, people living with HIV, and underserved families to expand access to education, care, essential support, and opportunity.
aboutTitle: Hope should be within everyone’s reach.
aboutText: Naya Aasha means “New Hope.” We believe every person deserves dignity, care, education, and a fair opportunity to build a better future. Our work begins by listening to communities and responding with practical, inclusive support.
programsTitle: Care that meets people where they are.
ctaTitle: Help turn compassion into lasting change.
ctaText: Give time, share skills, partner with us, or support a program. Every meaningful contribution can open a new path forward.
